properties.name: wireguard-mesh-ws-tunnel
properties.description: WireGuard-over-TCP/443 fallback for hostile networks (airport / hotel / corporate guest Wi-Fi blocking UDP). Sibling to bb-net_wireguard-mesh (the panel) — this folder owns the wstunnel-server that terminates WSS on gcp-proxy and forwards UDP to the kernel WG listener at 127.0.0.1:51820. UDP/51820 remains the primary transport; this kicks in only when clients can't reach UDP.

properties.name: caddy-l4-public
properties.description: Public-edge Caddy-L4 SNI mux on oci-analytics. Owns the public 0.0.0.0:443. SNI allowlist *.diegonmarcos.com → TCP-relay to gcp-proxy via wg-public (10.1.0.2:443; oci-analytics is the hub at 10.1.0.1, gcp-proxy is the spoke at 10.1.0.2). Unmatched SNI gets TCP RST. Pure layer-4 — does NOT terminate TLS; the gcp-proxy Caddy edge still handles all cert + routing logic. This makes oci-analytics THE single public-edge VM per the wg-public hardening design (operator policy 2026-05-23): gcp-proxy stays fully private, c3-public-api remains the only application surface directly served from oci-analytics; everything else either flows through this L4 relay to gcp-proxy or peers join wg-public to reach 10.1.0.2:443 directly.
